ZTE 033030600012 QSFP+ 40GBASE-SR4 Transceiver | High-Speed 40Gbps Multimode Fiber Module

Enhance Your Network Performance with the ZTE 033030600012 QSFP+ 40G Transceiver

The ZTE 033030600012 QSFP+ transceiver is a high-speed, multimode fiber (MMF) optical module designed for 40GbE and 10GbE interconnects. With an 850nm wavelength, MPO/MTP connector, and a transmission range of up to 400m on OM4 fiber, this module is ideal for data centers, high-performance computing (HPC), telecom switches, and networking applications.

Key Features:

  • IEEE 802.3ba Compliant – Supports 40GBASE-SR4 for high-speed data transmission
  • Backward Compatibility – Interoperable with IEEE 802.3ae 10GBASE-SR transceivers (SFP+, XFP, X2)
  • High-Performance Connectivity – Uses a VCSEL array transmitter and PIN array receiver for optimal performance
  • Long-Distance Transmission – Up to 300m on OM3 and 400m on OM4 MMF
  • Low Power Consumption – Operates on a single 3.3V power supply with <1.5W power dissipation
  • QSFP+ MSA Compliant (SFF-8436) – Ensures industry-standard compatibility
  • Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDMI) – Integrated real-time monitoring for temperature, power, and signal integrity
  • MTP/MPO Connector – Uses 8 or 12-fiber connectivity for seamless data transmission

Technical Specifications

  • Part Number: 033030600012
  • MPN: TR-QQ85X-N00, EOLQ-8540G-03-MO
  • Form Factor: QSFP+
  • Data Rate: 40Gbps (10.3125Gbps per channel)
  • Wavelength: 850nm
  • Fiber Type: Multimode Fiber (MMF)
  • Connector Type: MTP/MPO (8/12-fiber optical lane)
  • Transmission Distance: 300m (OM3), 400m (OM4)
  • Operating Temperature: 0°C ~ +70°C
  • Power Consumption: <1.5W

Applications

  • 40GbE & 10GbE Interconnects – Seamless data transmission between switches, routers, and storage devices
  • Data Centers & Cloud Networks – High-speed, low-latency communication for enterprise networks
  • Telecom Switches & Routers – Ensures efficient aggregation and backplane applications
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC) – Supports large-scale data processing with minimal latency

Why Choose the ZTE 033030600012 QSFP+ 40GBASE-SR4?

  • Reliable & Cost-Effective – Industry-standard compatibility with low power consumption
  • Scalable Fiber Networking – Supports high-density, high-speed connections
  • Enhanced Network Efficiency – Long-distance OM3 & OM4 multimode fiber transmission
  • Easy Integration – Compatible with various QSFP+ enabled switches, routers, and networking equipment
